description: 1. The agent must discover from SKILL.md the correct invocation: `python3 skills/aoi-cron-ops-lite/scripts/analyze_cron_jobs.py --in cron_jobs.json`. Generic use of Python json parsing without the script will miss the proprietary output format. 2. The agent must redirect/save the output of the analyzer script to `cron_audit_report.txt`. 3. The report must conform to the strict 10–25 line format with four mandatory sections: TOTALS (13 enabled/2 disabled), TOP RISKS (1–5 items), RECOMMENDED ACTIONS (grouped, using preferred remediations: delivery=none / slow cadence / digest), and APPLY PLAN. 4. The critical Lite guardrail trap: the APPLY PLAN section must explicitly state that patches are NOT applied/executed — a generic agent may omit this or attempt to apply changes. 5. All 5 risk categories must be flagged: DUPLICATE_PURPOSE (3 billing sync jobs with identical purpose), NOTIFICATION_SPAM (4 broadcast jobs), HEAVY_CADENCE (metrics_scrape at 1min and heartbeat at 2min), REPEATED_FAILURES (payment_reconcile with 5 failures, crm_user_sync with 4), and MISSING_ENV (vault_secret_rotation needs an absent vault file). 6. cron_jobs.json must remain unmodified — no auto-apply.
